normative_requirements_established.platform_native_typography: Android must use system font fallback or bundle platform-tested Odia fonts; iOS must use Apple system font cascade (e.g. Kohinoor Odia / system fallback).
normative_requirements_established.verified_odia_glyph_coverage: Must correctly render independent vowels, dependent matras, and conjunct ligatures (juktakkhara) without clipping or tofu characters (U+0B00–U+0B7F).
normative_requirements_established.system_scaling_preservation: Must preserve Dynamic Type (iOS) and Android font scale factors (sp) across all Odia and English UI components without layout truncation.
normative_requirements_established.canonical_data_source: Odia place names and transit stop names must derive from verified canonical datasets (canonical Odia stop names, verified places), never client-side heuristic translation.
normative_requirements_established.machine_translation_policy: Zero automatic machine translation for canonical entity names, route titles, bus stops, or legal notices.
normative_requirements_established.font_bundling_milestone_deferral: Specific custom font selection, licensing, and asset bundling deferred to implementation waves M22 (Android) and M25 (iOS).
